title: DR reflection plan: data-store layer (24 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the data-store layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

operations.rationale: Remove data-store.storedlogic.validates.data-store.collection: data-store.storedlogic.accesses.data-store.collection already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.56; claims rel:data-store.storedlogic#3.

evidence.quote: The validates relationship from data-store.storedlogic to data-store.collection is a testing predicate that overlaps with accesses, and imperative triggers are excluded from ValidationRule. Proposed: Remove the validates relationship from storedlogic to collection, relying on accesses.

Outcome: alternative (predicate=accesses).
